指数退避+抖动
每次重新排队取共享令牌

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: master 成功返回非空源 DSL？

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fallback 最多 1+F 次
同一共享并发/排队/执行超时

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: fallback 成功返回非空源 DSL？

div.style: color: rgb(59, 10, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FAILED / A2UI_GENERATION_FAILED
不进入转换、校验和保存

div.style: color: rgb(7, 43, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 得到完整 Design Compact DSL

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ModelExecutionRuntime
第三至第五接口、Create/Edit、
首次生成、重试、fallback、repair 共用

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
请求共享 asyncio.Semaphore
model_max_concurrency 默认 20 / 每进程

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
无令牌：协程排队，不占线程
heartbeat 继续；默认最多等 120 秒

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
排队超时 → MODEL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT
作为本次模型异常参与重试/fallback

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
取得 1 个令牌
开始一次物理 provider 调用

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MEP/DeepSeek：异步网络，不占工作线程
llmclient：专用线程池，默认最多 20 worker

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
执行超过独立请求超时
默认 120 秒？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MEP/DeepSeek：取消请求并抛超时
随后释放模型令牌

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
llmclient：不能强杀线程
继续占令牌直到真实调用结束
丢弃迟到结果后再抛超时

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
成功或异常均在 finally 释放令牌
退避 sleep 不占令牌；下一次重试重新排队

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mock 绕过 Semaphore
AnyIO 线程令牌 80 与模型令牌 20 相互独立

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
